verdict.rationale: Increase documents Check Transfers: it prints and mails physical checks for you, holds the funds until deposit, and tracks each check through mailing, deposit and returns (increase-docs-4, increase-docs-23, increase-docs-39). The other half of the story, depositing checks with image capture, is not evidenced; the docs only say funds can be received 'via checks' without describing a deposit or image-capture flow (increase-docs-10, increase-docs-43). Missing for 10: documented check deposit with image capture (remote deposit capture), an explicit check-issuance API endpoint reference, and independent hands-on corroboration.
